title: Tint Attends FreightWaves 2023
body_markdown:
The second annual[F3: Future of Freight Festival](https://live.freightwaves.com/f3-future-of-freight-festival-2023) has come and gone, leaving the freight and logistics industry abuzz with excitement and innovation. As the CEO and co-founder of[Tint](https://www.tint.ai/) , it was an honor and an energizing experience to be a part of F3 , held at the Chattanooga Convention Center. The convergence of experts, entrepreneurs, industry leaders, and educators provided an unparalleled platform to delve into the key factors shaping freight markets and explore the latest trends propelling the industry forward.


## Expo Floor and The Blue Room


This year, Tint had the privilege of attending and sponsoring the event. Our booth was a hive of activity, attracting professionals eager to explore[embedded protection](https://www.tint.ai/glossary) and the future of insurance. However, our exclusive backstage area, the Blue Room, truly set us apart. Formerly known as the green room, our rebranding symbolized our commitment to innovation and a fresh perspective in the world of freight and logistics.


The Blue Room became a hub of conversations. In this place, industry leaders and disruptors alike could relax, network, and share insights away from the hustle and bustle of the conference floor. It was our way of fostering connections, sparking discussions, and contributing to the vibrant tapestry of ideas shaping the future of freight.


## Immersive Networking and Industry Peers


One of the F3 2023 experience highlights was the chance to connect with industry peers, mingle with supply chain leaders, and expand our network. Beyond the structured sessions, the informal conversations in the hallways and at the Blue Room provided a deeper understanding of the challenges and opportunities facing the freight and logistics sector.


The weekend was a whirlwind of learning and collaboration. It was inspiring to witness the passion and dedication of professionals committed to driving innovation and efficiency in every corner of the industry.


## Innovation at the Heart of F3 2023


Innovation took center stage at F3 2023, and it was invigorating to be a part of discussions that will shape the future of freight. The freight and logistics industry is evolving rapidly, and at Tint, we are poised to deepen these conversations.


Throughout the conference, it became evident that two trends were dominating the discourse. Firstly, the right cargo insurance and[shipping protection](https://www.tint.ai/glossary) are mission-critical for the industry. Freight brokers are pivotal in validating carriers' insurance, ensuring a seamless and secure transportation process. Secondly, the complexity of the industry, with its multiple layers, presents numerous opportunities to offer the right insurance at the right time.


## Mission-Critical Insurance for the Freight Industry


Helping shippers obtain better insurance emerged as a competitive advantage for companies in the space. As we engaged in countless conversations, it became apparent that the industry's success hinges on a robust insurance framework. Brokers, TMSs, and loadboards all play integral roles in ensuring that the proper protection is in place, ready to be accessed when and where it is needed.


For instance, offering easy access to excess cargo insurance when shippers book their loads addresses a critical need in the industry. Streamlining this process not only enhances efficiency but also contributes to the overall resilience of the supply chain.


## Looking to the Future with Embedded Protection


As we conclude our experience at F3 2023, the Tint team is motivated and energized. Being a part of the innovative freight and logistics industry is a commitment and a passion. We look forward to the partnerships that see the potential of embedded protection in shaping the future.


In the spirit of collaboration, we invite industry professionals to explore the possibilities of enhanced cargo insurance and protection. The industry's complexities require solutions that optimize conventional options, and Tint is at the forefront, ready to provide innovative, embedded protection for the evolving needs of the freight and logistics sector.


## Connect with Our Protection Experts


If you're ready to revolutionize your approach to cargo insurance and protection, don't hesitate to[reach out to one of our protection experts](https://www.tint.ai/3pl-freight-broker-growth-with-embedded-protection) . At Tint, we believe in safeguarding the future of freight, one innovative solution at a time. Let's navigate the complexities together and pave the way for a more secure and efficient industry.


In the words of F3 2023, let's shape the future of freight together.
